text.en: AlphaTensor is row 114 of the BenchCouncil AI100 (2022-2023) annual table in the AI4Others area.
text.zh: AlphaTensor 是 BenchCouncil AI100（2022-2023）年度表第 114 行，所属领域为“AI 其他应用”。

text.en: The annual table associates AlphaTensor with “Discovering faster matrix multiplication algorithms with reinforcement learning”.
text.zh: 年度表把 AlphaTensor 与论文《Discovering faster matrix multiplication algorithms with reinforcement learning》关联。

text.en: The Main Contributors field is “Alhussein Fawzi, Matej Balog, Aja Huang, Thomas Hubert, Bernardino Romera-Paredes, Pushmeet Kohli”.
text.zh: “主要人物”字段依次列出 侯赛因·法兹、马泰·巴洛格、黄士杰、托马斯·于贝尔、贝尔纳迪诺·罗梅拉-帕雷德斯、普什米特·科利；官方英文原文为“Alhussein Fawzi, Matej Balog, Aja Huang, Thomas Hubert, Bernardino Romera-Paredes, Pushmeet Kohli”。

text.en: AlphaTensor uses alphazero-style search over tensor decompositions.
text.zh: AlphaTensor 采用在张量分解空间中进行 AlphaZero 式搜索。

text.en: Experts generally treat AlphaTensor as a landmark for AI-assisted algorithm discovery because the output is an explicit, verifiable algorithm. It broadened the AlphaZero paradigm from board games to mathematical search and inspired later work on optimizing low-level computation.
text.zh: 专家通常把 AlphaTensor 视为 AI 辅助算法发现的里程碑，因为其输出是明确且可验证的算法。它把 AlphaZero 范式从棋类扩展到数学搜索，并推动了后续底层计算优化研究。
